summary: Pro and Community installations are now set up the same way, so both behave predictably.

new.title: Same daily edition check for every installation
new.text: Every installation now checks its edition with Invardia once a day. A licence or trial for your tenant then arrives by itself.

fixes.title: Installations carry their real edition
fixes.text: Every installation was labelled Community in Azure, Pro included. It now shows its real edition.

fixes.title: Community installs are ready from day one
fixes.text: Community installations now prepare the Invardia support link at install, like Pro, and every installation updates itself right after install, so it is current at once.
